text: Every clinic gets the same flood. Referrals, pathology, radiology, all arriving as PDFs.
Each one has to be read, classified, and routed to the right doctor's inbox by hand. It's slow, and it's the kind of work that quietly burns a day a week.
This tool turns those PDFs into HL7 messages your practice software files automatically.

Heads up — what you're about to see is the operator portal, used for one-off uploads and spot checks. The production pipeline runs fully automated, end to end. No clicks, no logins, no humans in the loop.
To use the portal, sign in with the password your administrator gave you. Sessions last seven days, so you only do this once a week.
Set your carrier code and paste in your clinic's doctor list. The app remembers these in your browser, so this is a one-time setup.
Drag any patient PDF into the dropzone — referrals, pathology, radiology, consent forms, even mixed batches. Queue as many as you like.

Hit convert. Claude vision reads each document, classifies it, pulls out the patient details, and matches the addressee to the right doctor on your list — even when the letter just says, Dear Rheumatologist.
Download the HL7 file, or drop it straight into your practice software's inbound folder. The file is tagged so it lands in the right inbox automatically.
Every conversion is logged for compliance. Again — this is the portal flow. In production, the same engine runs unattended on every inbound document. Sign in above to try the portal.
